content: Webmin stack working end-to-end (45/45 harness): demosthenesk/webmin:noble image (pschatzmann Alpine dead), seed /etc/webmin from image via webmin-seed container (bind mount shadows miniserv.conf), tmpfs /tmp /run /var/log /var/webmin with read_only, locale it_IT.UTF-8 (bare 'it' crashes conmon), nix TMPDIR scoped via /etc/conf.d/nix-daemon not global export.
